name: SoloFleet Personal Inbox
description: SoloFleet program layer for OpenClaw: completion gate, audit guard, desktop lock, approval handling, pending-decision ledger, reply card and note inbox.

syncRoot.description: Absolute project root for registered document sync targets; defaults to the main workspace's project parent.

enabled.description: Reply card (model, route, effort, changed files) under each reply. On by default; set false to turn it off.

quotaSource.description: Remaining-quota readout on the reply card. 'off' (default): no quota line; the card still shows model, route, effort and changed files. 'cli': sample the CodexBar CLI (needs credentialProfilePath). 'cache': read a widget export file (snapshotPath).

snapshotPath.description: Exact existing widget quota export for explicit legacy cache mode only; CLI mode does not read this path.

credentialProfilePath.description: Path of the Claude credential profile, used only as a non-secret fingerprint to match the quota source to your account; file contents are never read. Only needed for quotaSource 'cli' or 'cache'.
